changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: with candidate as ( select id from infra_data_source where upper(type) <> 'INCEPTOR' order by updated_at desc nulls last, created_at desc nulls last limit 1 ), needs_update as ( select 1 where exists ( select 1 from infra_data_source where is_default = true and upper(type) = 'INCEPTOR' ) or not exists ( select 1 from infra_data_source where is_default = true ) ) update infra_data_source set is_default = (id = (select id from candidate)) where exists (select 1 from needs_update) and exists (select 1 from candidate);
